name: Stephen J. Hemsley

career.title: Rose to managing partner (strategy and planning) and chief financial officer
Executive Chairman / Chairman of the Board

background_rationale: An accountant by training who rose to CFO and managing partner at Arthur Andersen before joining UnitedHealth as an operating executive.

notable.summary: Returned as CEO effective immediately upon Andrew Witty's departure, as UnitedHealth suspended its 2025 outlook citing higher-than-expected medical costs in Medicare Advantage.
Days after returning, bought about $25 million of UnitedHealth stock at an average price of about $288.57 per share, according to a Form 4 filing.
Testified alongside other health insurance CEOs at a January 22, 2026 congressional hearing on health care costs.
UnitedHealth raised its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $19.50-$20.00 after second-quarter results, while shedding Medicare Advantage members and exiting unprofitable Optum Health contracts.

personal_story.hook: An accountant from Arthur Andersen, Stephen Hemsley ran UnitedHealth for 11 years, stepped back, then returned at 72.
personal_story.summary: Hemsley earned an accounting degree from Fordham University in 1974 and built his early career at Arthur Andersen, rising to managing partner and chief financial officer. He joined UnitedHealth in 1997 as chief operating officer, became president in 1999 and CEO in 2006, and moved to the chairman's role in 2017. Fortune once described him as unusually publicity-averse, and he has shared little publicly about his personal life. In May 2025 he returned as CEO during a period of rising medical costs and a share-price collapse.
